name: SSHI_Bridge_LC_Filter
rationale: The best previous design (SSHI_Bridge_Clamp) failed on startup time (too slow) and ripple (too high) for some conditions. There is a trade-off: increasing C1 reduces ripple but slows startup. To break this trade-off, I am adding a second inductor L2 as a low-pass filter between the rectifier bridge and the storage capacitor C1. This allows using a smaller C1 for fast startup while L2 handles the current ripple, ensuring vpp <= 20mV. The Zener clamp remains at the output to prevent overvoltage.
